text_block_list.text: Whoosh... Boom!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Spe! Grass! Tonight's the summer
carnaval!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We can't lose to any of those masked
people!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We all need to shake our fists in the air,
wiggle
our hips, and commence
mamboing! That means
you two as well!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm not going that far. Japanese culture
is also
about elegance.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'll do it, El! I don't know how much
wiggling I can
actually do, but I'm in!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
The summer festival has a much bigger
turnout
than I expected.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, Trainer! Get a load of that group
over
there!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Even the old people aren't getting tired!
And that
dance! It's so funky and cool!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Sure enough, their movements certainly
seem to
belie their age.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wearing a mask lets you become a
different
person. I explain that they wear
the masks to
become incarnations of the
gods and to pray for
a good harvest and
good health.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ya veo! I see! So they aren't doing it to hide their true identities.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We've got some stiff competition, but
we're
Umamusume! We run and dance
for a living!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We're not gonna lose! Not even to
incarnations of
the gods!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Let's go, Spe!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Whoa! Wait!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
The festival dance seems to go on
forever.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... I can't keep going, El...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Qué? But Spe, look how happy everyone
looks.
They're counting on us for a good
performance!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that just make all your
exhaustion go
away? I can dance forever
knowing everyone is
having a good time.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Not at aaall... Maybe it would if this
were to win a
race, but...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: I... I'm just not a party person!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: A party person... Hmmm...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: You have a unique strength.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You can convert the support of others
into your
own power.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Ah...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: So that's what she meant...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Whoosh... Boom!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What's wrong, El? Are you angry?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Not at all! I'll take it from here, Spe!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Who's today's top bill? The summer
child with the
spirit of a local, who loves
entertaining more than
anything!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The name is Эль Кондор Паса! And I'm
taking the
dance circle by storm!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса ends up being the only
person
who could dance throughout the
whole festival.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: After the festival...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I figured out what Suzuka meant today,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I convert support into my own strength.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All Umamusume run with the
encouragement from
the cheers of the
crowd, our heads filled with
dreams of
victory.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: But I don't just do it to win. I run to win and entertain.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
What does it mean to be the world's
strongest
racer? It means being the
world's greatest
entertainer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Looks like I found another dream.
Although, I
think it might've been there
all along.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's just like with those masked people at
the
festival.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Everyone gets real excited, combines
their
wishes, puts on their masks, and
then dances!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All in order to have the best time
possible!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's what's different between
me and the
others. And not only that,
I've got...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: The gift from your father, right?

text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All my papa's dreams rest in this mask...
and now,
they've been passed down to
me.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса takes off her mask in the
light of
the moon and places it on a
rock.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I don't wear this mask to hide myself.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I wear it to become stronger than
anyone else...
and to entertain.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even if she didn't realize it before, El
Condor
Pasa's always entertained the
masses with her
over-the-top actions and
boasting.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even at the Takarazuka Kinen, when she

overcame Сайленс Судзука...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm certain one of the reasons she was
able to do
that was her desire to delight
the audience.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please don't forget... why I do
this.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Don't forget that my true dream is to
entertain
everyone.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: If you understand...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Then please... offer your feelings to this
mask too.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We close our eyes and pray together—a
lovely
festival rite in which to prepare
for the upcoming
fall.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
